Match THEIR art direction closely: elegant stylized adult arcade/anime anatomy, confident angular silhouettes, small selective dark pixel outlines, smooth broad flat color masses built from crisp pixel clusters, restrained three-to-four-tone shading ramps, sparse high-contrast accent edges. Match their full-body head-to-body proportions and their portrait facial rendering. Do NOT interpret this as realistic tactical game art, photoreal texture, gritty stippled noise, chibi, oversized cartoon heads, thick toy proportions, or generic detailed illustration. Keep normal stylized adult fighter anatomy like the approved sheets, NOT ultra-realistic tiny head or childish huge head. Mostly cool gray/black with pale silver shapes and tiny amber light.

Generous at least 7% transparent cell padding on all sides. All body and accessories inside own cell. Full-body frames face RIGHT, identical proportions and consistent feet baseline. Standing characters fill about 80% of each cell height.

Cell7 bottom left: defeated sitting with one knee raised, forearm on knee, head lowered, simplified stylized torn jacket edge and scratched but opaque mask. Still faceless.

Cell9 bottom right: large clean head-and-shoulders portrait, matching E2B/Modal portrait line weight and flat shading, charcoal hood and featureless black visor, pale gray collar and amber tiny indicator, no damage.
All nine images redrawn coherently in the APPROVED E2B/MODAL visual language. No photoreal material texture or noisy grunge. Do not copy other characters into this atlas.

Subject: an original retired street fighter turned ringside judge. Middle-aged man with warm brown skin, swept-back SILVER hair, small healed eyebrow scar, angular expressive anime-arcade face closely matching the references' portrait style. Small amber optical implant at one temple, both eyes plainly visible for expressions. Sharply tailored CHARCOAL jacket, prominent high PLUM collar/lapels, cream shirt, sparse gold hardware. Calm dry authority, difficult to impress; handsome seasoned adult, not an old cartoon professor, no glasses, no fluffy beard, no oversized head. No resemblance to any requested real person. This is an unofficial original Jev-inspired character concept.
Prop: thin dark clipboard/scorecard with a slim AMBER illuminated edge, a few blank pale ruled marks but NO readable scores or letters, ordinary pen. All props held or touching character, no floating elements.
COMPOSITION: waist-up SEATED ringside judge, facing almost front with slight three-quarter turn toward RIGHT, same fixed camera and same head/torso scale across ALL eight images. Crop at same waist baseline; hands/forearms inside cell. No desk or chair drawn (UI can supply desk). Torso and collar form same readable silhouette across poses. 2 TOP MIDDLE: Studying scorecard, eyes down, pen poised against clipboard, thoughtful focused expression.
3 TOP RIGHT: Skeptical, one raised eyebrow, head tilted slightly, pursed lips, clipboard held low like neutral.
4 MIDDLE LEFT: Impressed, subtle raised eyebrows and faint approving half smile, tiny head lift, keep adult restrained expression, not cartoon surprise.
5 MIDDLE MIDDLE: Deliberating, one hand against chin, other holds clipboard at waist, narrowed thoughtful eyes.
6 MIDDLE RIGHT: Announcing verdict, lifts amber-edged scorecard near chest angled toward viewer, free hand small open presentation gesture, composed authoritative expression. No readable scores.

8 BOTTOM MIDDLE: Neutral CLOSED-EYES blink variation, MUST match cell1 exactly except eyelids closed, NOT sleepy expression or tilted head.
9 BOTTOM RIGHT: entirely transparent empty cell.
Same person, outfit, face proportions, implant, silver hair silhouette, rendering and camera across all eight. Clean, sharply clustered arcade pixel art like approved refs, NO photorealism, no gritty texture noise, no round cartoon mascot proportions.
